testResults.name: authenticated-option-contract
testResults.result: Options use the same authenticated catalog, ensure, file-query, and bounded-SQL response/job semantics as equities while retaining canonical OSI partition paths.

decisions: create_app now exposes contract_repository and front_set_repository injection points and stores them on application state for production and test composition.
The option route implementation continues to use the existing contract and daily front-set repository boundaries rather than adding a parallel catalog.
limitations: No live option-provider or Azure data-plane request was performed; tests use in-memory repositories and local Parquet/DuckDB fixtures.
